title: Class Booking Software for Studios: 8 Compared (2026)
description: Class booking software for yoga, dance, pilates and martial arts studios: Vagaro, Arketa, WellnessLiving, Gymdesk, Mindbody, Zen Planner, Walla, Mariana Tek.
body:
Class booking software puts your schedule online so students can reserve a spot, join a waitlist, cancel and pay from a phone or your website. For yoga, pilates, dance and martial arts studios, the differences that matter are how pricing scales (per calendar, per staff, per member or per location), whether waitlists and spot booking are included, and what you pay on each transaction.

We checked each vendor's own public pricing and feature pages on November 11, 2026 and list only what they publish. Anything a vendor doesn't publish is marked unknown. We have not used these tools ourselves and we don't publish ratings.

{{table:vagaro,arketa,wellnessliving,gymdesk,mindbody,zen-planner,walla,mariana-tek}}

How each tool handles class booking

  • Vagaro: $30/mo for one bookable calendar ($23.99/mo for the first 6 months); each extra bookable calendar is $10/mo (US) up to seven licenses, then more employees at no extra cost. Lists classes, customer waitlist options, a free Vagaro Marketplace listing and booking through Google, Apple Maps, Instagram, Alexa and Facebook. 30-day free trial; cancel any time with no cancellation fees (Vagaro pricing).
  • Arketa: Individual plan $49/mo billed annually (save 17%) with one team member login, plus a 3% transaction fee on top of Stripe fees (2.9% + $0.30 in the US). Studio plans are quote only. Lists a booking app, check-in, waitlist management, advanced booking windows, workshops and events, and a ClassPass integration (Arketa pricing).
  • WellnessLiving: Starter $69/mo ($62/mo billed annually) for one staff member; Business $199/mo ($179 annually) and BusinessPro $349/mo ($314 annually) for unlimited staff. On November 11, 2026 the page showed 80% off the first 2 months of Business and BusinessPro. Lists configurable wait lists, Book-a-Spot, and Reserve with Google, Wellhub and ClassPass integrations (WellnessLiving pricing).
  • Gymdesk: a class schedule members book and manage from their phone, plus a member app (Gymdesk homepage). $75/mo with Gymdesk Payments or $100/mo with your own processor for up to 50 active members, rising by member tier; 30-day trial with no credit card (Gymdesk pricing). Waitlist support isn't stated on those pages (unknown).
  • Mindbody: Starter from $79/mo per location with unlimited users, booking, branded widgets and a Mindbody app listing; Pick-a-Spot and room/resource management are on higher plans whose prices aren't published. New clients who find you through the Mindbody app carry a 20% fee (capped at $30) on their first purchase (Mindbody pricing). See our Mindbody pricing breakdown.
  • Zen Planner: online class scheduling is in every tier; Studio runs $99/mo (0-45 active members) to $289/mo (251+), month to month (Zen Planner active-member tiers). Its feature page lists waitlists, capacity limits and automatic reminders (Zen Planner membership management).
  • Walla: plans start at $299/mo per location (Core); Pro and Scale are contact-sales. Every plan lists unlimited users, classes, appointments and enrollments, Book-a-Spot and waitlists with notifications, and website widgets plus the Walla app. The page says there are no booking fees for your clients (Walla pricing).
  • Mariana Tek: no published prices (book a demo). Every plan includes custom-branded iOS and Android apps and kiosk check-in; Mariana Tek charges Stripe's standard flat rate for card payments and says onboarding typically takes five to eight weeks (Mariana Tek pricing). It lists pick-a-spot with custom floor plans for reformers and bikes on its homepage.

How the pricing models compare

  • Per bookable calendar: Vagaro ($30/mo, +$10 per extra calendar up to seven).
  • Per staff: WellnessLiving Starter ($69/mo) covers one staff member; Business ($199/mo) is unlimited. Arketa Individual ($49/mo annually) is one login.
  • Per active member: Gymdesk ($75-$200/mo with Gymdesk Payments, up to 250 members) and Zen Planner ($99-$289/mo on Studio).
  • Per location, unlimited users: Mindbody (from $79/mo) and Walla (from $299/mo).
  • Quote only: Mariana Tek, Arketa Studio plans, Mindbody Accelerate and Ultimate, Walla Pro and Scale.

What to test in a free trial

  • Book, cancel and join a waitlist as a student on a phone. How many taps does it take?
  • Does the waitlist promote people automatically, and are late-cancel or no-show fees supported?
  • Can students pick a spot (mat, reformer, bike) if your room needs it?
  • What does each booking cost you in card fees and any platform or marketplace fee?
  • Do class packs, memberships and drop-ins all work in the same checkout?

For martial arts schools, booking usually needs to feed attendance and belt eligibility; see martial arts attendance software and BJJ class scheduling software. For yoga and dance, compare full suites in best yoga studio software and dance studio software comparison.

Which to shortlist

For the lowest published entry price, Vagaro ($30/mo, one calendar) and Arketa Individual ($49/mo billed annually, plus a 3% transaction fee) suit solo instructors. Studios with several instructors can compare WellnessLiving Business ($199/mo, unlimited staff), Mindbody Starter (from $79/mo per location, unlimited users) and Walla Core ($299/mo per location). Membership gyms and martial arts schools that price by member count can compare Gymdesk (from $75/mo) and Zen Planner (from $99/mo). Boutique studios that want their own branded app and spot booking can request a Mariana Tek quote. {{aff:marianatek|Visit Mariana Tek}} {{aff:wellnessliving|Visit WellnessLiving}}

faq: It is studio software that publishes your class schedule online so students can reserve, cancel, join waitlists and pay from a phone or your website. All eight tools on this page list online class booking on their own pages (checked 2026-11-11).
What is the cheapest class booking software for a small studio?

Among the tools here, Vagaro publishes the lowest entry price: $30/mo for one bookable calendar, or $23.99/mo for the first 6 months (vagaro.com/pro/pricing). Arketa's Individual plan is $49/mo billed annually plus a 3% transaction fee on top of Stripe fees (arketa.com/pricing).
Which class booking tools include waitlists?

Vagaro (customer waitlist options), Arketa (waitlist management), WellnessLiving (configurable wait lists), Zen Planner (waitlists and capacity limits) and Walla (waitlists with notifications on every plan) list waitlists on their own pages. Gymdesk's pricing and homepage don't mention waitlists, so confirm in a trial.
Which tools let students pick a spot in class?

WellnessLiving lists Book-a-Spot, Walla lists Book-a-Spot on every plan, Mariana Tek lists pick-a-spot with custom floor plans, and Mindbody includes Pick-a-Spot on its Accelerate and Ultimate plans, which have no published price.
Do these tools charge a fee per booking?

Walla's pricing page says there are no booking fees for your clients. Mindbody charges a 20% fee (capped at $30) on the first purchase of a new client who finds you through the Mindbody app. Arketa's Individual plan adds a 3% transaction fee on top of Stripe fees. Card processing rates for most other tools aren't published.
